name: Easy2Say
description: On-device conversation assistant: live transcription, AI cues (concepts, bios, answers, suggestions) on the glasses, optional translation, and a post-conversation review — all computed on the phone, nothing leaves the device.

permissions.description: Used for live transcription and AI cues

hardwareRequirements.description: Shows live cues and transcription on display glasses; the phone UI works without one
Captures speech for transcription and cues

actions.description: Start an Easy2Say session: listens to the conversation on-device, shows AI cues (concepts, bios, answers, suggestions) on the glasses, optionally translates, and produces a post-conversation review. Use when the user wants conversation assistance, live cues, or 'easy2say'. Pass language to set the conversation language and targetLanguage to enable translation; omit both to keep saved choices.

language.description: The conversation's spoken language as a BCP-47 code (e.g. 'en', 'zh-TW', 'ja'). Use 'zh-TW' for Traditional Chinese; bare 'zh' means Simplified. Omit to keep the saved language.

targetLanguage.description: Optional translation target as a BCP-47 code. When set, live translation turns on and cues can be generated in this language. Omit to keep the saved translation setting.
